decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( GLA-01L (existing floor plans), GLA-01L (proposed floor plans) & GLA-03L; received 28/08/2018.  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) the premises shall not be used other than as an opticians (within Use Class D1) and for no other purpose, including any of the other uses falling within the D1 use class.
description: Change of use from office to optician
